skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Cloud in Foreign Lands
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cloud in Foreign Lands. Clothes Windscoot wears while enjoying a solo trip in faraway lands during a break from work. A comfy short-sleeved shirt paired with lightweight sneakers allows him to enjoy this moment of relaxing freedom.
skins.quote: Here, far from the vagaries of human emotion, Windscoot forgets all those worldly struggles between good and evil and cracks open a cold can of soda. On this summer's day, he learns what is meant by content relaxation.
